bio: Located on the Welsh/English border of rural Shropshire lies the small, family run Kerry Vale Vineyard. Enjoy a relaxing day in these beautiful surroundings, followed by a traditional Afternoon Tea in the vineyard's inviting Wine Cafe. The spread will include a range of finger sandwiches, scones with jam and clotted cream, macaroons, delicate pastries and a freshly brewed pot of tea.
